_comment: ONLY what Xero cannot know. The roster itself is built at run time from
Xero inventory items, payroll employees and repeating bills - see
src/roster.py. Nobody has to be added here to be found.
Keyed on the inventory item code, because that is the one stable key. A
person's name arrives as 'Dat Le', 'Dat Tien Le' and 'Le, Dat'; matching
on a name once split one contractor into two and moved $60,000.
folder   - where their files already live on OneDrive, when it does NOT
match <client>_<item name>. Ten years of folders carry typos
('Deepati Bansal') and the misspelling is load-bearing: correct
it here and every existing file stops matching.
name     - the person as everyone refers to them, where the Xero item name
is a fuller legal form.
cadence  - 'monthly' for the offshore team. Default is fortnightly. Monthly
people still file into the CURRENT FORTNIGHT folder - Andrew's
decision, 2 Sep 2026 - so there is one folder to look in, not two.
MAY DIFFER BY SIDE. Peter Small is billed FORTNIGHTLY by
TecAlliance and invoiced MONTHLY to Xenon Media, so his entry
reads {"sales": "monthly", "bills": "fortnightly"} rather than a
plain string. Marking him monthly outright would pull his
fortnightly bill out of the fortnightly run and stop him being
paid on time. A plain string still means both sides.
emails   - an address they also send from. Normally not needed: the address
period_day - for a MONTHLY person whose cycle is OFFSET from the calendar
month. 12 means the 12th of the preceding month to the 11th of
the current one, and fill_period_drafts writes that window as the
invoice reference: '12 August to 11 September 2026'. Absent means
calendar month, and no reference is written for those - their
house format is a month label ('Deepti Bansal May 2026'), not a
range. Prasanthi is the only offset person as at 3 Sep 2026.
is read for their name first. Needed only where the address
cannot carry the name, e.g. Bhasker Veela signs 'Veerla Bhaskar'.
skip     - true for a payroll employee who is NOT a swept contractor:
super-only records and monthly salaried staff Andrew runs himself.
They are real employees, so the roster finds them; without this
they are chased every fortnight for a timesheet they never send.
ignore   - true for an inventory item that is not a person at all. Keeps
SEEK ads and training products out of the coverage report.

Linfox - PD._why: Prasanthi's cycle runs the 12th of the preceding month to the 11th of the current one, not the calendar month - Andrew, 3 Sep 2026. She is the ONLY offset person; Bhasker, Deepti and Vivek are calendar month.

Tec - PS.name: Peter Small
Tec - PS._why: SPLIT CADENCE. TecAlliance bill him fortnightly; Xenon Media are invoiced MONTHLY, and the monthly invoice is the sum of the fortnights ENDING in that calendar month - so a month catching three fortnight-ends bills three, not two. August 2026 was one of those: 47.96 + 42.23 + 47.95 = 138.14 hours, against a usual ~90. Without this entry the fortnightly run treated him as fortnightly and would have stamped '17 August to 30 August 2026' over his 'Peter Little August' reference. Andrew, 4 Sep 2026.
